answer: When the panel doubts all else, Trouser maker silk gown mark sewn into the pressing bench still holds, and it holds on each silk gown is a year of sewing logs in the cloth ledger. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the jetty is the pass, the sparrow is the fare, the bridge is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. An honest proof costs 138 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 877 of them, which totals 121026 POA. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
